messages:
suresh: Heads-up — staging canary failed to fallback automatically. ops UI shows 403 when calling fallback endpoint. stack trace attached. Error: `permission denied: rollout.execute_fallback`.

amy: can you paste the curl and response?

suresh: ```
curl -X POST https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/rollouts/rl-123/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
# response
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"forbidden","reason":"permission denied: rollout.execute_fallback"}
```

jordan: is this the `infra-runner` sa used by canaries? we rotated KMS keys yesterday, could've changed the principal mapping.

maria: @jordan good call — I can't find any audit events for these calls in the audit-log index. suspicious. security-bot, did we drop logs?

security-bot: Alert: missing-audit-events detected for service_account=infra-runner, since=2026-03-12T00:00Z. KMS key mismatch detected for key_id=projects/.../keys/staging-ops. See runbook: <https://go/redwood/runbooks/missing-audit-events>

amy: if the service account principal changed, RBAC policies that reference the old principal won't match. quickest mitigation: add explicit role grant to the user/group that triggers fallback (ops.rollout role) or allow the API to accept fallback requests signed by service tokens scoped to `rollout:execute:staging`.

suresh: short-term patch: add fallback endpoint to "allow_internal" for internal service tokens. will submit PR to edge-proxy: `allow_internal:true` behind a feature flag. not ideal but unblocks canary rollback.

jordan: please also add an audit-event emit on 403 so we can trace who attempted it. missing audit logs are the bigger issue.

maria: I'll run a quick query to rehydrate missing logs from the lb access logs and attach to the incident timeline.

suresh: plan: (1) hotfix edge-proxy (allow_internal flag) — PR in 30m, (2) run `redwoodctl auth role grant ops rollout.execute_fallback --env staging` and add migration to policies repo, (3) re-run canary after grant, (4) root cause: KMS principal mapping; security team to triage and rotate mapping back or update policies.

amy: include test in policies CI: ensure role names don't hard-code SA emails; prefer principal="serviceAccount:infra-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" wildcard.

jordan: I'll schedule canary retry once PR is merged. ping me here with deploy link.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for edge-proxy PR #432, staging -> in progress :rocket:

suresh: thanks all. I'll open the policies PR and the incident ticket (INC-2026-147). will update timeline there. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. rehydrating logs now, will paste link when done. :eyes:
